notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Flumph indestructible.
description:
Give Flumph indestructible by any method.
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding Dakmor Salvage, dealing 2 damage to Flumph.
Flumph triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
